description: Ministry of Public Security - Amendment to the Fee for registration National Identity Card for the First time - (Registration of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968 Notification Under Section 9 (2) (bb) (I)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the revision of fees and regulatory changes under the Registration of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968. It contains legal notifications under specific sections of the Act (Sections 9(2)(bb)(i), 16(2)(b)(i), and 17), making it a regulatory matter that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification. While it mentions Minister Tiran Alles, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, so it does not qualify as a government-related type (1-3). The content focuses on legal instruments and fee regulations rather than personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
